title: Weigh Yourself Every Morning
hook: Here's how to know if your fat loss plan is working.
body: Weigh yourself every morning, right after the bathroom and before you eat or drink anything. Same scale, same time, every day. Your weight bounces two or three pounds a day from water and salt, so compare your 7 day average to last week's. Stalled for a full week? Cut 200 calories a day and keep going.
close: Save this for your next weigh-in.
